fieldValues.title: P1 Living Decisions
fieldValues.summary: A group uses the SRS-web governance workspace to review commitments when due and supersede decisions with an accountable history.
fieldValues.body:
## Track

P

## Actor

Group returning to its decisions over time

## Durable Artifact

Upgradable decision repository with living-decision history.

## Entry Criteria

- F1 is closed
- SRS-web safe-to-try governance baseline exists

## Included Capabilities

- Work With Meaning
- Preserve Meaning
- Present Facets

## Exclusions

- Projected Protocol facilitation
- AI-assisted drafting

## Walkthrough

In srs-web, upgrade a repository, identify a decision due for review, supersede it, and inspect the resulting history.

## Compatibility Promise

Package upgrades and supersession preserve prior decision meaning and lineage.

## Stable After

The SRS-web governance workspace supports decisions as a maintained practice, not a one-time log.
